releases.body: Fix Token Monsters active-session scope, preserve cached sessions, persist sidebar open state, and update click handlers.
Fix stale output counts by merging live TUI message state with captured token breakdowns and refreshing immediately on message updates.
Fix OpenCode npm plugin loading by splitting server and TUI into supported package entrypoints. Server is exported from the package root and TUI is exported from ./tui.
Initial npm-ready Token Monsters package. Add it to OpenCode with @aundal/opencode-token-monsters@latest. README includes a copy-paste prompt to make OpenCode install it into its own config.
